text_block_list.text:
Summer camp begins. Мэйсё Дото is
planning to
spend her stay discreetly,
not wanting to bother
the talented T.M.
Opera O and Адмайр Вега.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, reality far exceeds Meisho
Doto's
expectations—her peers, in full
acknowledgment
of her skills, welcome
her into the group. Meisho
Doto
couldn't be happier.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Their summertime kicks off with an
unexpected
friend—a tanuki—coming
along and quickly
warming up to Doto.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
